what: PAIRED difference-of-differences through the common h800 rung: candidate k8x1376 (11008) MINUS deploy champion k4x688 (2752), same decks, same opponent.
why: Corrects a same-day misreading that compared the two runs' UNPAIRED elo point estimates (+123.0 vs +135.0, sigma~18.5 each) and reported a 12-elo 'sign flip' / ~2.4sigma contradiction with the direct H2H. Both runs share seed band 24e9 and are deck-paired, so the paired statistic is available and is the correct one.

reconciliation.verdict: CONSISTENT (z=1.19, n.s.). Same sign, magnitudes agree within noise. CL-060 was closed on an UNDERPOWERED design, not refuted by a conflicting one. The direct H2H is more sensitive: no third-party variance, and no ceiling compression from measuring two near-equals through an opponent both beat by ~9 pts/deck.
reconciliation.note: +1.12 pts/deck at z=0.86 is precisely CL-060's own recorded closure figure, so the closure always rested on this statistic.
reconciliation.still_open: The H2H changed WIDTH and BUDGET together (k8x1376 vs k4x688). CL-054 established k4 beats k8 at fixed total 2752. The decomposition cell k4x2752 (11008) vs k4x688 (2752) isolates BUDGET at fixed width.
